_doc: Locke's lines, keyed by room id then trigger. 'default' covers every room. Fields: text (shown beside Locke), glyph (input action whose button is shown small beside it; omit for none), clip (optional URL of a recorded line, e.g. /audio/vo/tut-a-move.ogg), hum (placeholder vocal when no clip: hum | grunt | chuckle | tsk). Triggers: orbit, move, stretch, flatten, sidle, place, rotate, crouch, lift, contact, fumble, rewind, escape.

orbit.text: Case the joint first. Clock's not running.

stretch.text: Why walk when you can reach?

flatten.text: Sideways. Like a card up a sleeve.

place.text: Mirror, mirror… show me the off switch.

rotate.text: A touch this way… or that.

fumble.text: Let's take that again, from the top.
